Name: (AT) Cute Pink and White Craftables for Alternative Textures
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
So I've had some of these textures sitting in my files for years now, from a time before the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]Cute Valley Pink[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/36871425]Rosalie[/url] encompassed as much of the game as it does now; back when, I started retexturing the craftables for myself to match my farm. I didn't end up doing anything public with it, as I never finished, and Rosalie added so much to her mod. However, now that the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url], means you can use multiple texture sets, I thought I'd share the craftables I'd made and see about making a more complete set.

The craftable set is mostly complete, with a good chunk of them done- almost all the machines for your farm, and a handful of other decorations and such! Finished items include the following;
[i]
Auto-grabber, Auto petter, Basic Log, Bee House, Bone Mill, Campfire, Cask, Charcoal Kiln, Cheese Press, Chest, Crab Pot, Crystalarium, Deconstructor, Enricher, Farm Computer, Feed Hopper, Furnace, Garden Pot, Geode Crusher, Gold Brazier, Heavy Tapper, Hopper, Incubator, Iron Lamppost, Junimo Chest, [i]Junimo Kart Arcade System, [/i]Keg, Lightning Rod, Log Section, Loom, Mayonnaise Machine, Mini-Shipping Bin, Nozzle, Oil Maker, Ornamental Hay Bale, Ostrich Incubator, Plush Bunny, Prairie King Arcade System, Preserves Jar, Recycling Machine, Seed Maker, Skull Brazier, Slime Egg-Press, Slime Incubator, Tapper, Telephone, Wicked Statue, Wood Chipper, Wood Lamppost, Worm Bin, Barrel Brazier, Carved Brazier, Coffee Maker, Cursed Prairie King Arcade System, Dark Sign, Iridium Sprinkler, Marble Brazier, Mini-Fridge, Mini-Jukebox, Mini-Obelisk, Mushroom Box, Quality Sprinkler, Sewing Machine, Soda Machine, Solar Panel, Sprinkler, Stardew Hero Trophy, Statue Of Endless Fortune, Statue Of Perfection, Statue Of True Perfection, Stone Brazier, Stone Chest, Stone Sign, Stump Brazier, Wood Sign, Wooden Brazier, Workbench, Chicken Statue, Dried Sunflowers, Empty Capsule, Foroguemon, HMTGF, House Plant, Obsidian Vase, Pinky Lemon, Seasonal Decor, Sign of the Vessel, Singing Stone, Sloth Skeleton, Standing Geode, Stone Cairn, Stone Frog, Stone Junimo, Stone Owl, Stone Parrot, Strange Capsule, Tub o' Flowers[/i]

If there's anything missing that I haven't retextured yet, and you'd like to see it, let me know!

I currently have no plans on making a cute white and blue set of craftables. If you're a user of Rosalie's Cute Valley Blue mod, and would like more blue craftables for AT, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11698]Shardust's Colorful Craftables for Alternative Textures[/url], which can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11698]here[/url], and which has multiple blue sets!



[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[AT] Cute Pink and White Craftables' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] tool from Robin, to use on your items and retexture them.
[b]4. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to retexture! Enjoy your new farm!
